glaze_ui.blocker: Notify still carries historical 1.3.0 source mappings. Current Stable Glaze UI 1.5.1 implementation and representative web/native/accessibility/performance/rollback/production acceptance are required.

wardveil_security.blocker: Notify declares a fail-closed Wardveil application adoption candidate with explicit source evidence. Target runtime acceptance remains required and production_approved remains false.

privacy_shield.blocker: Notify declares a source-side draft Privacy Shield adapter limited to data-minimization and deletion-controls. Runtime and central adapter acceptance remain required, and production_approved remains false.

everkeep.blocker: Notify declares an Everkeep adoption and fail-closed acceptance-policy candidate. Target-native restore/recovery evidence and exact-revision Everkeep acceptance remain required before readiness can be asserted.

manager.blocker: Accepted GoreeCloud Manager administrative and operational-visibility integration is not established for Notify.

goreecloud_mesh.blocker: Mesh registration, capability publication, event contracts, dependency declarations, and runtime acceptance are not established.

goreecloud_identity.blocker: Notify has internal human-session and producer identity boundaries, but accepted GoreeCloud Identity integration is not established.

goreecloud_policy.blocker: The v3.0 GoreeCloud Policy responsibility has not yet been integrated or accepted; existing application authorization rules are not a substitute for the shared policy system.

goreecloud_observability.blocker: Notify has application-local operational logging and monitoring checks, but accepted GoreeCloud Observability integration and evidence contracts are not established.
